turns.text: Hey, what's up? How are you doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How much should I spend on a wedding gift for a coworker?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a coworker, somewhere around fifty to seventy five dollars is common. Something from their registry is always a safe bet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if I'm not invited to the actual wedding, just the office card?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then chipping in for a group gift or adding a small amount to the card is plenty. Nobody expects a full gift in that case.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And I was going to

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: write something in the card but I'm terrible at that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it short. Something like, wishing you both a lifetime of happiness, congratulations on your big day, works perfectly.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You're welcome. A short warm note always beats a long awkward one.
